correctness.rationale: Uniqueness of simplicial barycentric coordinates identifies the geometric fixed set with the admissible full-orbit complex. For odd \(d=2s+1\), the exact maximum pair-distance identity \(sm+\delta_m(a,b)\) proves each face criterion for arbitrary nonempty sets and all real radii. For even \(d\), every orbit includes antipodes of separation \(n/2\), precluding earlier fixed points; at and after this threshold the whole Rips complex and fixed simplex are contractible. The isomorphisms are constructed independently of radius and respect all persistence maps and residual cycle symmetries. Finite verification: 407813 orbit-diameter evaluations, 49472 complete orbit face evaluations, and 202 signed reduced Lefschetz comparisons; these corroborate, do not replace, the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Provides an exact parameterwise classification of all rotational-subgroup geometric fixed-point Vietoris–Rips filtrations on every cyclic graph metric, including nontrivial fixed spaces under free vertex actions, a sharp parity obstruction, natural isomorphism of full persistence modules (not just pointwise Betti numbers), and residual symmetry. The infinite-family result derives concrete new fixed persistence in n=15,d=3 and transports the established rich odd-sphere cyclic Rips structure to all odd-order subgroup fixed filtrations. It is not merely a renaming of quotient metrics or a finite known table.
